lesson.meaning: Happening sometimes, but not regularly or often.
examples: We enjoy an occasional weekend trip to the mountains when we have time.
There might be an occasional need for overtime during peak season, but it's not common.
During the meeting, there were occasional technical glitches with the presentation software.
I have occasional calls with my mentor to discuss my career path.
Our team offers occasional workshops to help employees develop new skills.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'occasional' as something that happens 'on occasion' – not all the time, just once in a while!
